notes.content:

notes.title: 🧚‍♀️ Quality of Life update - Fairies, New Buildings, and UI Scaling! 🔮
notes.content:
Greetings Princesses & Princes, it's been a while since your Kingdoms have seen the light of an update but it's almost time!

Last July's 1.06 patch was supposed to be the last patch for Fabledom however… Your enthusiasm and love for the game made us reflect on our decision to stop post-release support and we have not one but two Quality of Life update coming up! While Grenaa Games oversaw their development, this would not have been possible without the help of Fabledom's Game Designer, Hippolyte Azalbert, and our friends at Celsius Online spearheading the development! So, without further ado, let's start with the first Quality of life update as more detail will be coming up later about the 2nd one.
 
A magical new update will arrive in your kingdom on March 26th! Get ready for Fairies, UI scaling, and brand-new buildings to enhance your kingdom. Here’s what’s in store: 

🧚‍ UI Scaling

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/448751cae0b7b46d20302d4d3a0a07bde1cc2241.gif

The long-awaited UI scaling feature is almost here! You will be able to adjust the user interface to perfectly fit larger screens, enhancing your Fabledom experience. 

🔮 New Inhabitants - Fairies! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/92261acc6dc6992ee70380b95a1385e3c90d0525.gif

Meet the Fairies, mystical creatures ready to transport goods across your realm! Unlike your Fablings, they don’t need food or sleep, making them incredibly efficient. But their magic comes at a price, they’ll only work for those who provide Prismatic Liquid and grand Fairy Towers! 

Fairies are most useful in the late game, freeing up your Fablings to focus on other tasks, whether it’s working the fields or relaxing at home! 

🧚‍ New Buildings: Fairy Tower & Fairy Pillars

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/d135f31e98cf19fd4c8bfcb93dcc2a2cc5439e75.gif
Fairy Tower: The Fairy Tower is a unique building that can house up to 5 Fairies. It will help you transport resources within a radius around the tower. This building costs a large amount of Gold, Prismatic Liquid, Planks and requires upkeep.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/a0857174b54e70abd8afd12eb1876d4337f8216b.gif
Fairy Pillars: Smaller than the Fairy Tower, Fairy Pillars accommodate up to 2 additional Fairies. These can be placed anywhere and transport resources within their radius. This building costs about half as much as the Tower.

🔮 Prismatic Liquid

To summon Fairies, you’ll need to gather Prismatic Liquid. Once you have enough, these magical creatures will be ready to streamline your resource transport and leave your Fablings to handle other tasks! 

🎮 Console Update Coming Soon 

The patch will be coming to consoles later. More information will be available in the coming months! 

We hope you will enjoy these exciting new features and improvements in Fabledom. We can’t wait to see how the Fairies help shape your kingdom! Stay tuned for even more updates soon.

notes.title: 🏰 Patch 1.06 🏰
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/d67a539c98c3c550baf010d7fb03b069646dcfb0.jpg

🏰 Patch 1.06 Is Available Now 🏰

📝 Dev Notes 📝
Patch 1.06 is expected to be the final patch for Fabledom. Thank you for your support from Early Access to the 1.0 release. We're happy to have you in our community!

New Features
🎃 FINALLY FINALLY! A Giant Pumpkin and a Puppy in the Dog House 🐶
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/c54289c29e86f5e4ec04b07588c571c05ee601dc.png

Fixes

 Fixed bug where flag lines wouldn't spawn after construction completed and wouldn't play the placing animation if one of the connection points was marked as loaded.
 Fixed issue where loading a save would break flag lines' animation.
 Fixed issue where relocating wouldn't reset flag lines properly.
 Fixed some particle effects that were playing on load even though the game starts paused.
 Fixed construction progress shader not being affected by cloud shadows and appearing radioactive during winter.
 Fixed some missions showing a negative relationship effect that shouldn't have.
 Fixed emissary gnomes event having strange option titles.
 Fixed issue where missions with no expiration would show a strange tooltip.
 Fixed issue where locked resources would not be removed when a player throws a wedding.
 Added restriction on mass destruction of palaces.
 Added flagline connection points to townhouse well and regular well.
 Fixed issue where prismatic liquid could sometimes be covered in grass.
 Fixed issue where buildings wouldn't display their effect range on placement begin, only after being moved by a certain amount.
 Removed the feedback button (For future bug issues, please write on Discord or in Steam discussions).
 Fixed issue where musical garden ground wouldn't enable.
 Fixed issue where clock tower grass would clip.
 Fixed issue where decorations with foundations wouldn't be displayed before being constructed.
 Fixed lack of construction ground texture in:
[olist]
 Stockpile
 Market
 Barracks
 Wood bridge
 Stone bridge
[/olist]  Fixed banks, arc of pigs, flower queen, musical garden and ancient stone guardian using incorrect construction poles.
 Fixed farm and hospital not having water drop effects.
 Fixed issue where military overview UI of huge armies would overlap other panels.
 Fixed windmill missing windows.
 Fixed several models (added rain and frost effects).
 Fixed harvest guild decorations clipping through walls.
 Fixed sign post floating.
 Fixed issue where Dark Knight's third date wouldn't update properly if fortification level was already at 10.
 Fixed issue where Ramone's third date would subtract too much happiness.
 Fixed major issue with happiness where having trolls or dragon active while receiving other happiness bonuses would add their debuff one more time, stacking each time. This fix also addresses old saves affected by the bug.
 Fixed Bob not being red.
 Fixed Bob's branches being white.
 Fixed maze garden not having ground texture.
 Fixed grass capturing issue on load.

Optimisations

 Fixed a memory leak related to grass around trees and accessing mesh data for construction.
 Resolved memory access leaks associated with flag lines.
 Optimized the rendering process for large amounts of areas simultaneously.
 Heavily optimized the logic for drawing areas (preview area).
 Fixed an area rendering issue that caused overdraw on map edges.
 Optimized shadow casting for certain objects.

Quality of Life

 Added a setting to toggle muting audio on focus lost, addressing issues where players experienced no sound.
 Notifications are now colour-coded for improved clarity.

Thank you!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/772efd4f1c25cb39277504fa22fdae3b2c98c7cc.jpg

Dear Princesses & Princes,

We've been working so hard preparing for the 1.0 release. We are excited to share some more information with you, you can read part 1 of the devlog here!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1651560/view/4205874461260634333
[hr][/hr] 🐷 Achievements 🐷

FINALLY FINALLY! The achievements will be available in the 1.0. Let's see if you can unlock them all as some of them they are actually quite difficult. Are you up to the challenge? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/31b103373cb6cfecc281aa3bb9b1011af83067de.jpg
[hr][/hr] ☠ Challenging or Cozy💺 IT'S UP TO YOU!

In 1.0, we will add 4 difficulty levels: Calm 🐷, Classic 🐷, Challenge 😅 and Cruel ☠!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/b02d9743cc498406dd2cd82934ad81dd8d2537fa.png

The Classic difficulty is the one we are used to from EA. If you hover your mouse over the checkbox next to each difficulty, you'll see the change in values compared to the Classic, such as family aid cost, soldier health, hunger, extra winter days, yearly nobility and whether or not there's helpful gifts.

Our idea is to allow players to have different kinds of play style, whether you want to have a cozy & chill experience, or whether you want to have a challenging experience in managing your fablings. It's ALL UP TO YOU!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/fe069a69b46857f70e7cac7104fec93016a958f9.png
[hr][/hr] 📖 Localization 📖
Thanks for your feedback & support, we decided to add Japanese localization!

🎮 UI & Quality of Life 🎮
We've been focusing on improving the overall gaming experience. In 1.0, we've refined the world map UI for smoother navigation and reworked the categorization of structures for better organization. 

We have also improved the resource management by allowing players to lock resources in stockpiles and granaries. And the marketplace will now be able to pick up resources from these two locations.

Military units and foundations will no longer block each other. We've also tweaked the UI to make military control easier than before. And XP will be awarded to the hero when missions are completed. 

We've also implemented and addressed several issues reported in previous versions, as well as implemented features suggested by the community, like being able to view the amount of residents/workers in a building more easily, new chapter prompts, additional letters for all rulers,  and much more!

Dear Princesses & Princes,

1.0 is coming on May 13 and we have been so excited to share the new content with you in detail. So, without further ado, let's get started!

🗿 Troll Invasions 🗿

We have a new threat to our kingdoms, the trolls. Actually, to get them into the kingdom, the prerequisite is to build a Mystic Mine, which can help you to earn coins at the expense of the trolls' appearance. If you wanna get rid of the trolls, you know what to do! 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/e437afee2855f4fca5e29003ee664dc761364958.gif

If you're willing to accept the challenge, the size of the troll invasions will depend on the amount of fortifications in your kingdom!

When a troll camp spawns, it will decrease the global happiness of your realm. If more active troll camps appear, the debuff value will increase! The only way to clear the debuff is to defeat the trolls!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/6c8d6f9147b1d17cd18d707810ec6452699d8a30.gif

New defensive weapons such as the Ballista, Cannon & Mortar will also be available! They're actually attached to the tower and each shot consumes 1 or 2 prismatic liquid, depending on the weapon that you're using!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/90556386692163c134f815c5b2b46153fbbad1e5.gif

🏹 New Army Management & Fortifications 🧱

Fergus will now provide a buff to all fablings according to his level, that will let them carry more resources! 

Once you build a Mystic mine, you unlock another new feature; "Fortification". The more walls, towers and defensive weapons you have, the higher the value gets. This means a few things:

[olist]
 Bonus coin from Mystic mine is increased.
 Troll invasion sizes are increased.
 Rewards for defeating trolls are increased.
[/olist] 
So, if you want higher bonuses and rewards, you need to take more risk!

 🌟 Fantastical Disasters 🌟

🐲 Flying Dragon 🐲 

Our fablings are so scared of the gigantic beast... 

There will be special events where the dragon will spawn with a debuff for your Kingdom! 

You can give it what it wants to make it leave, or attack it with your ballistas! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/e9ae207fa491e231eaa275b88d24db471e5e6271.gif

🔮 The 3 witches 🔮

Like the dragon, they will spawn with debuffs to your realm! Spend your nobility to get them out of the door or ... take your time and make your decision! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/23d238ba7dbda5d44d810360159b28c040c7c4c6.gif

💌 Start courting with the New rulers 💌

🧰 Farrah, The Tinker Princess 🔨 

Farrah, the Tinker Princess who has a passion for industry and production. Let's start developing a relationship with Farrah! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/5f68a39582e8c7c99e010e080efb52792b901d83.jpg

Build a Tinkers guild to speed up the production by giving the guild some particular resources!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/08a71940a936eb86e4c2543ec69d51c23c00df2f.png

You can also build a regenerator to regenerate resources in iron and stone deposits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/7147d3137ab26b05c580a3d3da090c00f47254a6.gif

🗡 Sir Payne, the Dark Knight 🖤

Sir Payne, a cold Dark Knight, who enjoys suffering ... The gift of coal will absolutely warm his dark heart. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/4115b7544b629a828287867d029190b22a84cfdb.gif

By starting a relationship with Sir Payne, some courting gifts will be given! For example, the Strategic Council, where you can pay in coin and receive the Combat Intelligence buff, which reduces the health of all enemies by a percentage (depending on how much you invest)! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/73d80dadbb3a26896a36a33d39def767158ad583.png

Also, Sir Payne will pay you for every fabling you imprison. It's up to you to decide who though! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/8a0b4cbb98aa2063f8367f92609b53d1cf02ce1e.png
🎭 New buildings 🎡

In the 1.0, we also added a lot of new buildings for you to discover. It can take tons of resources to build a Mall, a Circus Tent, a Café, Arc of pigs or a Ferris Wheel... But at the end of the day, it's all about making your fablings happy!

Prepare yourself for new events that will bring new fantastical creatures to your realm, unfortunately this time they are not very friendly. 

🤴 New rulers 👸
It's finally time to meet the last 2 rulers in Fabledom; the Dark knight and the Tinker princess! As always, each ruler has unique buildings, items and objectives.

To recognize all the hard work that has gone into Fabledom, we've decided to increase its price from 15.99€/$ to 20.99€/$ starting after the end of the Spring Sale.

notes.title: Hotfix patch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/a30050f132a8743fc482017d74a6f0c0bab3f24b.jpg

Hello Community,

The previous hotfix had a big issue with relocation, where you would be able to relocate everything. 

There is a possibility that if you relocated housing, workplaces with staff or buildings with attachments in your save, that save could be broken. It is possible that destroying the buildings you relocated this way could fix it.

Thank you for your support!

Fixes

 Fixed issue where fences would load incorrectly.
 Fixed issue where tulips would break in winter.
 Fixed issue where an abandoned graveyard would take 200 coin from the player.
 Fixed issue where fablings could get stuck at street theatre.
 Fixed issue where pigs would not follow when relocating pig farm
 Fixed issue where you cannot type in the production limit boxes
 Fixed issue where you could relocate buildings with attachments.
 Fixed issue where rotating an amenity would also rotate the area of all other amenities of the same type.
 Fixed issue where you could climb beanstalk infinite amount of times.
 Fixed issue with grass appearing to clip
 Fixed bread blue texture
 Fixed god rays not scaling with zoom in/out


New features

 Can now relocate hubs as long as they have no active attachments
 Selecting decoration now shows all beauty areas instead of just areas with the same ID.
 Can't relocate buildings attached to resources anymore, these should be investments and re-using them feels wrong.


Balancing

 Peasants can now work in golden goose coop.


With love,

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/128f0ed6069f7a5e25880293d88faab7ea0163f8.gif

Dear princesses & princes,

The fairytale encounters can’t wait to meet you in the realm of Fabledom! The latest update – Fairytales & Community is now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/c1333a976e7c4df912e077cc6f74282913395984.jpg

Message from developer:
Finally! We have had a lot of fun working on this patch and it feels really nice to add a lot of QoL features we have been missing. The new content, especially all the new events and quests, have been a great addition, and we really believe players will enjoy it!

A huge thanks to our community for helping us identify all these QoL improvements and an extra big thanks to our Discord community, you are the best <3

Have fun my friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/bcd0f03dd4c978a304696d410db86899b091596e.png

Fairytale Encounters
[expand type=details]
The misunderstood cyclops

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/5bddc0386031cdb24feb880d8b7bf696120237c0.jpg

Eric one-eye has a chance to visit your realm for a few days, and it is up to you if you want to fight him or befriend him. Rumor is he will stay and roam your realm if you end up as friends!

Witches hut
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/5d33ef64ba7cf22c5fc4def6c77b329de028e956.png

You know her, you love to hate her, the witch is finally here in physical form. Why not visit her and see if you can’t get rid of her for good?

Redhooded girl

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/306534108ecbbb0a7a14efccb92a8d69fabc144d.jpg

Will you help this poor girl find her grandma's house?

Emissary gnomes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/c72c2eb945bfceb4a3751f764928c7093c00433f.jpg

Visitors from another realm looking to improve their reputation, it’s up to you if you want to help them!

Faun

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/81c5f67842c1d5f582d0637313396e4c532df5f9.png

The fluting faun has a chance to visit your realm, he loves to play his flute for trees and stones, perhaps his music can help somehow? 

And two more! Your turn to find them out!

 The Missing shoe
 The Wishing well
 [/expand]

New world events and quests

[expand type=details]
We have added over 50 new world events and 30 new objectives. Many follow a common thread and connect to each other, below are a few of our favourites.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/ac48565bbbbf03dbd5208c2b39c17eaad9ff4fc5.gif

 Magic bean 

A mysterious merchant visits your realm and offers you a magic bean or some very cheap food, surely feeding your fablings is a priority? But then again...

 Family matters 

Sick of paying family aid? Finally, we get to hear from our parents and our dear sister, perhaps we can lower our costs a bit?

 Monthly objectives 

It’s always nice to have some short-term goals, we have added over 20 new objectives that start via world events, each objective lasts 30 days.

 Yearly objectives 

Long-term goals are also nice, we have added over 10 objectives that will last over 90 days, but the rewards are quite nice!

 Taking the good with the bad 

We have added both positive and negative events, including a system that will add diminishing returns to event types, so you don’t need to worry about encountering all negative events. [/expand]

New Buildings

[expand type=details]
We have of course added some new buildings as well, one of which is making a triumphant return!

 Laborer guild 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/e97e1bc7762725822393ece8169928822e67d5cc.png

Guild laborers can carry more material and construct buildings faster than normal Laborers.

 Bank 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/d1ec3a0c3434f786da558a13ec91f1d698433f8b.png

The Bank unlocks the ability to tax your fablings at different rates, increasing your income at the cost of their happiness, and vice versa.

 Grand Theatre 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/86eabe756a2080d8ea49627c0f97aa283aeb3806.png

A stage for the best actors in the realm.

 Fisherman’s hut 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/04a13d88944c5be155ae3600f75d4672b329cf85.png

Fishermen gather available fish in the indicated area. Fish will re-spawn over time. [/expand]

Quality of Life

[expand type=details]
  Can now relocate buildings that have been placed.
 Debris now spawns on crop fields in winter, this must be cleared by the farmers before any more crops can grow.
 Added new graphs to help track resource production and consumption.
 Added option to generate worlds without hills or water.
 Added icon to buildings attached to a resource that has been depleted.
 Added desirability view.
 Added tax controls, unlocked by building a Bank.
 Happiness now effects fabling productivity.
 You can now disable the intro quests (tutorial).
 Added roads with sharp corners.
 Added several new vegetables.
 Marketeers are now more efficient than other storage workers.
 Decorations now add beauty to their surroundings, which can improve desirability.
 You can now set a production limit in workplaces.
 New improved system for picking world events, makes sure that you cannot get too many bad events in a row.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/7a21c27e74e18872763006417d2ad99148cac420.png
New vegetables

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/553521ac670b54ea5f28c942abf36b0a11c07f6b.png
Set production limit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/2a2fb5014db28bcdbcd19e012777eba195bc0bcf.png
Resource graph

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/494a07c82a852af2d60f608e2e5a182a78cc0529.png
Control taxes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/c3d8898ce0400e2ae53db171f8fd6c5debe64935.png
Decorations now add beauty
[/expand]

Optimization
[expand type=details] 
 Re-visited most shaders and removed/simplified unused or over-complex parts;
 Added more shader branches to allow for more quality settings (increases the FPS in lower qualities);
 Heavily simplified grass (removed SSS, real-time texture modulation, etc.);
 Re-worked the grass generation;
 Added Indirect Instancing to several structures that are used in big number in late game (walls, roads, fences);
 Added LODs (material/shader) to trees;
 Re-worked characters shader to reduce mesh count, and instead do the texture swamping in the shader;
 Reduced texture memory usage for some materials (grass, trees, etc.);
 [/expand]

Bug fixes and other tweaks
[expand type=details] 
 Fixed issue where coffer could be placed facing a building.
 Added improved tooltips.
 Eggs added to town shop.
 Added several more names to the pool of fabling names.
 Added more crest icons.
 Improved world event UI with some new icons.
 Added skin colours for soldiers.
 Flag-lines now automatically generate between some structures.
 Flag-lights now automatically generate between some structures.
 New animations when placing Homesteads.
 Several new narrator voice lines.
 Windows light up during winter.
 Added windows to most buildings;
 Fixed missing or incoherent cloud shadows in some buildings/structures/models;
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/e9c1f2dba69ee639a7795913b785f79c4da12a44.png
Winter lights
[/expand]

Will old saves work?
Old saves will work, but we recommend starting a new one for the best experience. 

For feedback, bugs and suggestions, join our Discord and discuss with devs!

All the known issues can be found here!

With love,
Terry

notes.title: DEVBLOG - Gallantry & Bartering
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/80078705e391848d609cac38c4175560f648d526.jpg

Princess & Princes,

I'm Terry, Community Developer of Dear Villagers. It is my honour to speak to all the princes and princesses about our next update - Gallantry & Bartering, coming on the 13th of July!

Today, Max, Game Director of Grenaa Games, is going to show you the ideas and inspiration behind these amazing features. 

[hr][/hr]

New level of inter-kingdom diplomacy!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/0562d7a11d1c0d938750ed08d2e0d7b10d2fa613.jpg
After placing the new Embassy, you will unlock the biggest new feature in this patch, the off-world missions. These missions have different rewards and require your help in one way or another.

"We are so glad that the missions are finally here, it has been a big part of our plan since day one and will be a mechanic that will evolve much more over time, eventually providing missions with unique rewards. Missions are a great way to get some use for your army while there is nothing to fight in your own realm."

Another system being introduced that is related to diplomacy is trading! It allows you to trade resources with a ruler while the relationship level has an impact on the exchange rate of goods.

While we are on the subject of trading, we might as well bring up our new world event "The traveling merchant" who will visit your kingdom regularly by offering a trade at a generous discount!

"Trading is another one of those features that we have been waiting to introduce forever and finally puts some weight on the relationship you have with the other ruler. It is heavily inspired by the trading system from the Civilization games."

Bard Prince Ramone
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/61a763057996c91b35cf95be0eaa211abf5a3704.jpg
New Ruler - Bard Prince Ramone, an 'unpredictable' free spirit who has roamed the lands on the wings of song. Unfortunately, he’s looking to settle down and build an artistic Kingdom supporting his whims and wisdom. Ramone is focused around amonities and happiness!

"Ramone is inspired by the classical bards and jesters from medieval times, and will hopefully guide the player to focus a bit more on amenities than the other rulers."

[hr][/hr]
New buildings and resources!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/ca6b1863e8f1d7c713cafac9ac7adafd8471664e.jpg
As you can see in the roadmap there are several new buildings in this patch. Since Embassy adds such a huge new feature in terms of diplomacy and trading, most of our time went to that, but we are happy to have time to add a new food resource in eggs to give some more variety. Eggs will also be used to make pastries in the future!

The marketplace is a great way to store resources inside towns to shorten the travel distance for workers!

[hr][/hr]

Hats unlocked AFTER THE SECOND DATE!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/0d1ce47215b29627f62557920b61cc387b7df158.jpg
The hats are a really fun way to make your hero stronger, and as we add more encounters over time they will play a bigger part in the game along with other items!

[hr][/hr]

Personalise the coat of arms of your Kingdom!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/36434e337c1dff3d8de1d40be797c058b90ca8bb.jpg
A classic, it's just fun to be able to personalize your kingdom a bit, and we plan to make all the flags in the realm use your chosen colors in the future!

[hr][/hr]

Will old saves work this time? 
Old saves will work, but we recommend you start a new one for the best experience.

[hr][/hr]

We finally meet! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/7d30e77da051c1b97f0386ff3128ec2b5652487a.jpg
Guess what, Max (in the middle of the photo), Game Director of Grenaa Games paid a visit to the office of Dear Villagers! 

We talked a lot about the development process and about you - our Fablings! 🐷

(Little quiz: Now you have found Max, but where am I in the photo?) - Share your answer with us on Discord!

For those who are already know the answer, please don’t tell!

See you soon!

With love,

Max & Terry
